ascendancies.notes: Deadeye is king — Gathering Winds (Tailwind), Endless Munitions (+2 proj), Ricochet (chain), Far Shot. Pathfinder for flask sustain in juiced maps. Raider for budget Onslaught/Frenzy.

gear_priorities.weapon: Flat lightning + attack speed bow. Budget: Tempest or Death's Opus. Endgame: rare Thicket Bow with +1 arrow, flat lightning, attack speed, crit. Mirror-tier: +2 arrows bow replaces Dying Sun.
gear_priorities.quiver: Rare with life, crit multi, flat lightning, attack speed. Endgame: +1 arrow quiver is massive for clear.
gear_priorities.helmet: Rare with life, res, -9% lightning res to nearby enemies (delve mod). Enchant: LA fires 2 additional projectiles.
gear_priorities.body_armour: Hyrri's Ire for budget (flat cold + evasion + spell dodge). Endgame: rare with life, spell suppression, crit chance. Top end: Farruls Fur for Aspect of the Cat.
gear_priorities.gloves: Rare with life, res, attack speed, flat lightning. Gripped Gloves base for proj damage implicit.
gear_priorities.boots: Rare with life, 30% movespeed, res, spell suppression. Two-Toned base for extra res. Onslaught on kill is a nice bonus.
gear_priorities.amulet: Rare with flat lightning, crit multi, life. Endgame: +1 lightning gems or Crystallised Omniscience for all-pen.
gear_priorities.rings: Flat lightning to attacks is THE stat. Mark of the Elder + Shaper ring combo for huge DPS. Budget: resist + flat lightning Topaz/Sapphire rings.
gear_priorities.belt: Stygian Vise with life, res, elemental damage. Abyssal jewel slot for extra flat lightning.
gear_priorities.flasks: Diamond Flask (crit), Dying Sun (+2 proj — massive for LA), Quicksilver, life flask. Endgame: Bottled Faith for crit + consecrated ground.

gem_links.bossing_swap: Swap GMP for Damage on Full Life or Lightning Penetration. Some players swap for Barrage setup instead.
gem_links.utility: Sniper's Mark on bosses. Assassin's Mark alternative for crit. Blood Rage for frenzy charges + attack speed.
gem_links.movement: Blink Arrow + Faster Attacks. Flame Dash as backup for crossing gaps.
gem_links.guard: Molten Shell with high armour from Grace + Iron Reflexes, or Steelskin if evasion-based.

tree_priorities: Bow clusters: King of the Hill, Ballistic Mastery, Fury Bolts, Master Fletcher
Lightning/elemental wheels: Heart of Thunder, Forces of Nature, Catalyse
Life: Herbalism, Thick Skin, Constitution, Blood Siphon
Crit: Depth Perception, Assassination (Shadow area), Heartseeker
Point Blank keystone if not using Far Shot ascendancy
breakpoints: 100% spell suppression — 50% less spell damage taken
100% hit chance — check with Precision + tree accuracy nodes
Ailment immunity — freeze from flask, shock from pantheon or mastery
75/75/75 elemental res (capped), -60% chaos res OK for softcore
5+ projectiles for comfortable clear (base + GMP + Dying Sun + quiver)
Diamond Flask + base crit > 7% for effective crit scaling
common_mistakes: Not stacking enough flat lightning on gear — LA scales from flat damage, not % increases alone. Rings, amulet, abyss jewels, gloves are your flat sources.
Running Wrath + Grace + Herald without enough mana reservation efficiency — you'll have no mana to attack. Plan Enlighten 3+ or drop a 50% aura.
Ignoring spell suppression — you WILL get one-shot by spell damage in red maps without it. Path to Suppression mastery near Ranger.
Using GMP for single target — swap to Damage on Full Life or Lightning Pen on bosses. GMP is a 26% LESS damage multiplier.
Skipping Precision — accuracy matters. A low-level Precision (Lv 10-15) costs almost no mana and fixes hit chance.
Not using Sniper's Mark on bosses — it's a huge damage multiplier for projectile builds, better than Assassin's Mark in most cases.
scaling_tips: LA's damage comes from stacking flat lightning everywhere (rings, amulet, abyss jewels, gloves) then multiplying with crit + elemental penetration. Trinity is your best support if you can balance lightning/cold damage. The skill hits once per arrow, so more projectiles = more clear, not more single target (unlike Tornado Shot).
